targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_process_entries WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_script_executions WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_script_executions WHERE is_encoded = true AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_privilege_escalations WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_container_activities WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM endpoint_container_activities WHERE activity_type = 'breakout_indicator' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as processes FROM endpoint_process_entries WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as shells FROM endpoint_process_entries WHERE is_shell = true AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) as time, COUNT(*) as scripts, SUM(CASE WHEN is_encoded THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as encoded FROM endpoint_script_executions WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) as time, COUNT(*) as escalations FROM endpoint_privilege_escalations WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT process_name, COUNT(*) as executions FROM endpoint_script_executions WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY process_name ORDER BY executions DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT escalation_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM endpoint_privilege_escalations WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY escalation_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT namespace_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM endpoint_container_activities WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY namespace_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT epe.process_name, epe.escalation_type, epe.original_user, epe.escalated_user, round(epe.confidence::numeric, 2) as confidence, epe.occurred_at FROM endpoint_privilege_escalations epe WHERE epe.confidence >= 0.8 ORDER BY epe.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT process_name, telemetry_source, script_source, LEFT(decoded_preview, 80) as preview, occurred_at FROM endpoint_script_executions WHERE is_encoded = true ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20
